interpretation.verdict_zh: 本轮SFT有可复核的实际收益，但没有实现综合中长句都强的目标。选中A在独立新主集合112条上chrF++44.17、BLEU25.11；原3B为41.27/21.67，配对chrF增益+2.90、95%区间[+1.17,+4.71]。新技术G8确认正确候选覆盖A5/16、原3B1/16、旧0.8B1/16；A中句3/6，长句仍0/6。保存A为当前3B翻译R0及受限试验候选，不将其认证为综合正式DAPO/Efficient-ML基线。
interpretation.verdict_en: SFT delivers reproducible gains, but the goal of a broadly strong medium/long-segment base is not met. Selected A scores 44.17 chrF++/25.11 BLEU on 112 fresh primary cases versus 41.27/21.67 for the original 3B, paired chrF gain+2.90 with 95% interval[+1.17, +4.71]. Fresh technical G8 good-candidate coverage is A 5/16, parent 1/16, older 0.8B1/16; A covers 3/6 medium but 0/6 long sources. Retain A as the current 3B translation R0 and restricted-pilot candidate, not a certified comprehensive DAPO/Efficient-ML baseline.
interpretation.actor_conclusion_zh: 相对原3B，主集合及技术中长句词面指标改善有配对区间支持，新G8也新增4个有G且有P/B的技术组。相对旧0.8B，主集合chrF增益+1.84但区间[-0.26,+3.83]跨零，不能称全面显著胜出。通用50条chrF35.71 vs35.24、BLEU12.58 vs14.41，均无可靠改善证据。技术greedy语义G2/16 vs原3B3/16，并未同步提升，不能将采样覆盖或词面增益解释成全面语义改善。
interpretation.actor_conclusion_en: Paired intervals support primary and medium/long technical metric gains over the parent; fresh G8 adds four technical groups containing both G and P/B. Versus older 0.8B, the primary chrF gain+1.84 has interval[-0.26, +3.83], so universal significant superiority is unsupported. General 50 scores 35.71 versus 35.24 chrF and 12.58 versus 14.41 BLEU, without reliable improvement. Technical greedy semantics are G=2/16 versus parent 3/16, not a parallel gain; sampling coverage and overlap metrics do not establish comprehensive semantic improvement.
interpretation.promotion_scope_zh: 晋升仅指保留为当前翻译R0候选和短/中句受限试验起点；不指综合正式基线已合格。
interpretation.promotion_scope_en: Promotion means the retained current translation R0 candidate and restricted short/medium pilot start; it does not certify a comprehensive formal baseline.
interpretation.DAPO_pilot_zh: 有条件可以做受限小试验，不需要宣布必须再SFT才能运行。先在独立的训练/开发池确认正确候选与组内差异，并让奖励通过语义对照；固定A后做小预算标准DAPO及零更新对照。新holdout及其G8来源继续冻结，不用于筛训练样本、改奖励或再挑权重。长句没有确认G的观察是当前限制，不是DAPO普遍准入门槛，也不是RL绝对无效证明。
interpretation.DAPO_pilot_en: A restricted small pilot is conditionally reasonable; another mandatory SFT round is not established. First confirm good candidates and within-group contrast on a separate training/development pool, and clear semantic reward controls; then compare fixed-A standard DAPO with a zero-update control under a small budget. Keep the fresh holdout/G8 sources frozen: do not use them to select training cases, tune reward or choose weights. No observed long-source G is a current limitation, not a universal DAPO threshold or proof that RL cannot help.
interpretation.reward_conclusion_zh: 历史奖励校准反例仍未通过，不能因本轮SFT进步宣布修复。选中A的旧技术诊断中，reference MetricX在4个含G组Top1均为G，但251对G/P/B比较仍有59次相反排序；QE为3/4。样本小、来源复用且为同一AI审查，未做全局奖励认证，也没有据此选择奖励模式。本轮没有DAPO更新。当前新QE数据池只进入B，选中A未训练该新池，因此不能把该池过滤与A的排序直接当作同源因果依赖。
interpretation.reward_conclusion_en: Historical reward-calibration counterexamples remain failed; SFT gains do not repair them. On selected A reused technical diagnostics, reference MetricX ranks G first in all four G-covered groups, but has 59 discordant of 251 comparable G/P/B pairs; QE top 1G is 3/4. Few reused sources and same-AI review do not certify global calibration, and no reward mode is selected from this check. This round has zero DAPO updates. The new QE-filtered pool enters B, not selected A, so that filtering is not direct current-pool exposure of A.
interpretation.next_step_zh: 不要默认继续堆同配置SFT，也不要把结果解释为0.8B或3B容量上限。先保留A、B及旧模型；本轮最终独立检验后不再训练或改选。下一轮分两条问题：其一，在另建且核验的训练/开发集复核短中句正确候选，并修复奖励失败对照，随后用A做受限标准DAPO/零更新对照，独立报告质量与语义；其二，若目标仍是综合长句强基座，先用经过语义核验的技术数据筛选真正有英冰翻译基础的起点，再在相同数据和预算上只改变一种SFT适应能力（如LoRA rank）做小对照。更高rank、embedding更新和全参数SFT本轮都没测，不能预先保证哪一种会解决。新池的已发现参考缺陷及领域误标须先修复并独立复审；不能让评分器过滤代替正确性认证。新评估集现已被查看，下一次最终验收应再冻结新的测试集。
interpretation.next_step_en: Do not default to more identical SFT or infer a 0.8B/3B capacity ceiling. Preserve A, B and older models; no training or reselection follows this final independent evaluation. Separate the next questions: (1)recheck short/medium candidate coverage on another verified training/development pool, repair failed reward controls, and run fixed-A restricted standard DAPO versus zero update with independent quality/semantic evaluation; (2)if broad long-segment strength remains the goal, first screen starts with demonstrable English-Icelandic ability on verified technical data, then change only one SFT adaptation factor, such as LoRA rank, under matched data/budget. Higher rank, embedding updates and full tuning are untested and no remedy is guaranteed. Repair discovered reference defects/domain mislabels and obtain disjoint review; scorer filtering is not semantic certification. This final set has now been inspected, so freeze a new test for the next final acceptance.
